issue_request: Published/Persuasive PA issue asking whether RelatedPerson.relationship should be related-person-to-patient or patient-to-related-person, with approved wording that the related person has the relationship with the patient and a mother-of-patient example.
initial_application: Commit 1188130b6c17ef475c055f86a5eb12a1a77f3525 applied FHIR-19411 by changing the RelatedPerson.relationship short and definition. Later FHIR-26994 commits replaced that with the current explicit directionality comment.
additional_context: FHIR-26994 is the later same-change-family issue and is decided by the seed audit commit. FHIR-15841 later split personal relationship from functional role, preserving the directionality comment while adding RelatedPerson.role. FHIR-29929 is related to the role/relationship split and is already represented on the combined branch. The January 2021 Zulip thread and September 2021 PA minutes support the same directionality and do not reveal a conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active RelatedPerson.relationship source now says the relationship is the personal relationship of the related person to the patient and explicitly states directionality from RelatedPerson to Patient.
